scope: Every capability SpaceAgriSim claims or is asked about, matched against the data that would actually be needed to support it. A gap here is a statement about evidence, not a to-do list: several will stay open on purpose because the data does not exist at any price.

gaps.capability: Predicted crop water use in litres per plant per day
gaps.needed: Measured evapotranspiration or sap-flow/lysimeter water use for the modelled crops at plant scale
gaps.available: Reference ET0 computed from reanalysis (FAO-56 Penman-Monteith, cross-validated against four sources), a learned emulator of that computed quantity, an 18-check ingestion validator, and — new in Phase 26 — one third-party measured dataset: gravimetric per-pot evapotranspiration of greenhouse lettuce (Schröder et al. 2021, 35 published pots, 380 usable pot-days), acquired, hashed and preprocessed in-repo with an out-of-sample comparison against the platform's water path.
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: A lysimeter or gravimetric water-use trial in the target growth system. No open dataset measures per-plant water use in a controlled-environment facility for lettuce or mizuna; this is a measurement to commission, not a download. New ingestion apparatus does not change the status: a validator can reject a bad measurement, it cannot create one.
gaps.currentStatus: open and blocking on its original terms, with its first measured evidence bench. The comparison artefact (ml/evaluation/phase26_measured_et_validation.json) shows the seasonal shape is broadly right (Spearman 0.7909 across 11 measurement days) while the level cannot be identified: on a pot-surface denominator the platform's flux is 0.247x the measurement, on a canopy-area denominator it is 2.7x. Because the study publishes neither pot diameter nor spacing, the sign of the discrepancy depends on an assumption, and no constant was changed.
gaps.severityMeaning: a claim in the product cannot be supported at all without this

stillBlockedBy: evapotranspiration includes substrate evaporation; transpiration is not separated
no per-day trial weather, so no reference ET0 and no crop coefficient
one cultivar, one greenhouse, four weeks, pot culture
evidenceAdded.closedGap: the 'no measured crop water use of any kind exists' clause only

gaps.capability: The claim that the ET0 target is itself correct
gaps.needed: A weather or ET0 source that does not share MERRA-2 lineage with POWER, and a measured latent-heat series to convert mutual agreement into physical truth
gaps.available: Four legs over 2021-2023 at six sites (6570 site-days): ERA5 0.25 deg hourly and daily, NASA POWER daily, ERA5-Land 0.1 deg temperature, and NOAA ISD station temperatures. Our FAO-56 implementation agrees with the provider's independent implementation on identical ERA5 forcing to bias +0.009 mm/d (MAE 0.181, R2 0.987), while the forcing difference between ERA5 and POWER is MAE 0.519 mm/d. The station leg is temperature-only (Hargreaves) and no leg measures latent heat.
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: Still needs (a) a Copernicus CDS token for the ERA5-Land hourly radiation and wind fields, which the credential-free delivery does not expose, and (b) a measured latent-heat series (eddy covariance or lysimeter) at at least one site, because reanalyses agreeing cannot establish absolute correctness.
gaps.currentStatus: open, partially addressed: disagreement now decomposed into formulation (0.273 mm/d), forcing (0.519) and implementation (+0.009) - the residual is weather, not code - but every leg is either a reanalysis or a temperature-only point method, so nothing here is field validation of the ET0 magnitude
gaps.severityMeaning: the claim is supportable only with a stated limitation that a user would notice

gaps.capability: Effect of Mars or lunar gravity on crop growth
gaps.needed: Yield or growth measurements at gravity levels other than 1 g, with the same cultivar and protocol as the terrestrial baseline
gaps.available: Terrestrial controlled-environment trials only (one 6-observation lettuce study, one OSDR study with harvest mass)
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: None available. Orbital and Mars-surface experiments produce too few replicates and too few cultivars to fit a response function; the honest position is that gravity response is a qualitative modifier with a stated uncertainty, never a trained coefficient.
gaps.currentStatus: open and permanently so for the current data landscape; the product must not present a gravity response as calibrated
gaps.severityMeaning: a claim in the product cannot be supported at all without this

gaps.capability: Response to specific LED spectra and photoperiods
gaps.needed: Biomass or yield response surfaces across spectra, PPFD and photoperiod for each supported crop
gaps.available: One study, six observations, one crop (lettuce), light intensity and temperature axes only Phase 26 added a hydroponic lettuce spectral-composition trial (Zenodo 20394352, 252 plants across four fixed spectra at constant PPFD and 16 h photoperiod), preprocessed but not yet consumed by a model.
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: The published CEA literature is large but fragmented: hundreds of small papers, no shared protocol, rarely any raw data. A meta-analysis with study-level random effects is the realistic route, and it needs a person reading papers, not an API.
gaps.currentStatus: open; DLI is computed from measured irradiance and the light-response coefficient is a literature estimate with a stated range
gaps.severityMeaning: the claim is supportable only with a stated limitation that a user would notice

evidenceAdded.note: spectrum is manipulated with PPFD held constant, so this dataset cannot separate a spectral effect from a total-light effect and does not address the photoperiod half of the gap

gaps.capability: Root-zone water status in a hydroponic or substrate system
gaps.needed: Substrate water content, irrigation schedule and drainage fraction at high temporal resolution
gaps.available: None. SMAP L4 gives 9 km root-zone soil moisture for open fields, which is a different system at a different scale.
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: Instrument the target system; there is no open dataset. SMAP would only be relevant if the platform modelled an open-field deployment.
gaps.currentStatus: open; the simulator models a water balance from demand, not from substrate state, and says so
gaps.severityMeaning: the claim is supportable only with a stated limitation that a user would notice

gaps.needed: Hourly temperature, humidity and radiation at the site
gaps.available: POWER daily aggregates. Daily Tmax/Tmin hides the duration and timing of an excursion.
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: POWER hourly endpoint (same API, same access) or ERA5-Land hourly. Partly closable today, but the ET0 validation in this phase deliberately stayed daily to match the reference formulation.
gaps.currentStatus: open; no heat-stress claim is made that depends on intra-day timing
gaps.severityMeaning: the claim is supportable; this would improve accuracy or resolution

gaps.needed: Cultivar identity and calibrated growth parameters per cultivar
gaps.available: A single parameter set per crop, with no cultivar dimension anywhere in the data
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: Cultivar trials in the target system. Breeder or seed-company data would be the natural source and is commercially restricted in practice.
gaps.currentStatus: open; the product exposes one parameter set per crop and does not offer a cultivar selector
gaps.severityMeaning: the claim is supportable only with a stated limitation that a user would notice

gaps.capability: Plant health or growth stage from imagery
gaps.needed: Labelled canopy imagery from the platform's own camera geometry
gaps.available: None in the repository. GWHD (wheat head detection) and PlantVillage (lab leaf disease) exist but describe different crops, different sensors and different tasks.
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: No imaging pipeline exists, so nothing is blocked today. If one is added, GWHD is the right labelled source for detection and PlantVillage is the wrong one for anything field-realistic.
gaps.currentStatus: open and deliberately not addressed; recorded so a future contributor does not train a lab-disease classifier and call it a capability
gaps.severityMeaning: the claim is supportable; this would improve accuracy or resolution

gaps.needed: Measured harvest mass with the same covariates the model uses
gaps.available: A small internal table plus six published lettuce observations used for external validation
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: More measured harvests with recorded light, temperature and duration. Until then the model's MAPE (41.7 %) is the honest number and the acceptance criterion is not met.
gaps.currentStatus: open; the model is registered as trained-exploratory and the failed criterion is exposed through the API
gaps.severityMeaning: a claim in the product cannot be supported at all without this

evidenceAdded.note: per-plant harvest mass now exists for lettuce in two independent experiments and tomato in one open-field experiment. None of them is a controlled-environment tomato or a mizuna experiment, and none is a spaceflight label.

gaps.capability: Energy and mass cost of a described mission
gaps.needed: Power draw per fixture, thermal load and resupply mass figures for real flight hardware
gaps.available: None. There is no power, thermal or logistics model in the repository.
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: Out of scope for the current product; would need hardware specifications from a mission integrator.
gaps.currentStatus: open and out of scope; no energy claim is made anywhere in the API
gaps.severityMeaning: the claim is supportable; this would improve accuracy or resolution

gaps.needed: Ion concentrations, uptake rates and EC/pH response per crop
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: Out of scope. Would be a separate model with its own data requirement.
gaps.severityMeaning: the claim is supportable; this would improve accuracy or resolution

gaps.capability: Siting for a future climate rather than the observed recent past
gaps.needed: Downscaled climate projections at the candidate sites
gaps.howCouldBeClosed: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 is the standard product and is open; it was outside this phase's scope because the reference ET0 study needed observed weather, not projections.
gaps.currentStatus: open; the product makes no future-climate claim
gaps.severityMeaning: the claim is supportable; this would improve accuracy or resolution
